id: estimate-deliveries
title: "Advisory delivery estimates for the items of a listing page"
description: "Called by the browser for a product listing (search results): one call for up to 50 items, each catalogItemId once, each with a quantity of 1 to 999. Relays delivery-promise POST /delivery-estimates for the postal prefix and returns its answer unchanged: one estimate per item in request order, with the best option per classic tier (SAME_DAY, NEXT_DAY, TWO_DAY, STANDARD) or the constraint that blocks the tier. The BFF never requests the CONSOLIDATED tier here (the request has no tiers field). An estimate is ADVISORY: it is not an offer, carries no offer id, cannot back a promise and reserves no capacity; the quote of the product page or of checkout is what the shopper promises against. The estimate window is {start, end, timeZone}, which a quote calls {earliest, latest, timeZone}. It is a safe POST: nothing is stored here or upstream, so no Idempotency-Key is required and one that is sent is ignored (delivery-promise ADR 0019, BFF ADR 0007). An invalid request answers 422 validation-failed before any upstream call; an upstream problem is relayed unchanged."

Called by the browser for a product listing (search results): one call for up to 50 items, each catalogItemId once, each with a quantity of 1 to 999. Relays delivery-promise POST /delivery-estimates for the postal prefix and returns its answer unchanged: one estimate per item in request order, with the best option per classic tier (SAME_DAY, NEXT_DAY, TWO_DAY, STANDARD) or the constraint that blocks the tier. The BFF never requests the CONSOLIDATED tier here (the request has no tiers field). An estimate is ADVISORY: it is not an offer, carries no offer id, cannot back a promise and reserves no capacity; the quote of the product page or of checkout is what the shopper promises against. The estimate window is \{start, end, timeZone\}, which a quote calls \{earliest, latest, timeZone\}. It is a safe POST: nothing is stored here or upstream, so no Idempotency-Key is required and one that is sent is ignored (delivery-promise ADR 0019, BFF ADR 0007). An invalid request answers 422 validation-failed before any upstream call; an upstream problem is relayed unchanged.
